preRepair.diagnosis: Groq, Gemini, and OpenRouter defaulted to a lifetime cap of 10 exchange records and locally refused; Claude absorbed every completion.

congestionDefect.cause: the prior scheduler treated temporary endpoint busyness as an unpriced reason to select the next supplier
congestionDefect.repair: frugality-v2 prices predicted capacity and RPM wait for every non-cooling candidate before selection; provider cooldown remains an explicit fallback signal
verification: waits for the cheaper supplier when congestion shadow cost is below the premium
buys the available supplier when congestion shadow cost exceeds the premium

remaining: OpenRouter currently returns a real provider 429 and must cool until provider capacity returns
no volunteer tailnet worker can be admitted until a host operator supplies URL, model alias, and protected key and the eight-request probe reaches 100% verified yield
socket activation is still needed so colonies do not manually launch the NDJSON broker
